g.text: Components of Reified RSpaces: the modules of every phase, the substrate of P1 in detail, and the host that they call
Frontend: source text to Par (P2, P3)
Interpreter at the baseline, with hook lines (P2, P4, P7)
Spaces: rholang/src/rust/interpreter/spaces/ and tensor/ (P4 to P7)
Mode backends (child modules of the hosts)
each deploy; spaces enter a block
send, sync send, input and new

hooks H2 to H4, receive, new, the
system_processes.rs: embed and ann are recorded
to R7, space references, the use context,
space intents in the operation order,

the play call order of ops_produce.rs

each operation meets its journal row
consume_lock: phase A, then phase B,
syntax: the source text, the parser, the normalizer arms and the syntax layer
code at the baseline: unchanged, or changed only by hook lines
Reified runtime: routing, scheduling, translation, Seq rules and costs (new code)
system processes and the exact numbers that they use (new code)
space agents and their parts, and the code of a user agent
services outside consensus: the VectorDB services, the mirror, ChromaDB
